variants.headline: Party leader faces a challenge
variants.body: A party's leader is being challenged in {colony}. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.

variants.headline: Leadership becomes a contested question
variants.body: A challenge to a party leader has opened in the colony. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.

variants.headline: A challenge inside the party
variants.body: The leadership of a political party is under challenge. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.
